HOW IT WORKS / 02

From connected agent
to accountable action.

Use AUVEN with agents running in your own application. The gateway applies your rules to supported requests and records the outcome.

01 / REGISTER

Give it an identity.

Name the agent, describe its purpose, and save the credential issued at registration.

◈
02 / CONTROL

Decide what can pass.

Set a daily limit and keep the agent active or stopped. The gateway rejects requests that fail a check.

⌁
03 / VERIFY

Inspect the evidence.

Review decisions, export signed checkpoints, and verify the signature independently.

▧
BUILT FOR VERIFIABLE ACTIVITY / 03

Post-quantum proof,
built into the record.

ML-DSA-65 signs agent passports and activity checkpoints. A verifier can check that an exported record is authentic and unchanged without trusting the dashboard alone.

Digital signatures are verified offchain. Blockchain proof commitments are a separate operation and require a configured mainnet signer.

PASSPORTML-DSA-65CHECKPOINT
